<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="900" height="150" viewBox="0 0 900 150" role="img" aria-label="Muhammad Tanjeem" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest">
  <style>
    .name { font: 700 40px 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #e6edf3; }
    .sub  { font: 400 17px 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #8b949e; }
    .mono { font: 500 15px 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; fill: #ff7a59; }
    .line { stroke: #ff7a59; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 120; stroke-dashoffset: 120; animation: draw 1.4s ease-out forwards; }
    .cursor { fill: #ff7a59; animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
    @keyframes draw  { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
    @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
      .name { fill: #1f2328; }
      .sub  { fill: #656d76; }
      .mono { fill: #d9480f; }
      .line { stroke: #d9480f; }
      .cursor { fill: #d9480f; }
    }
  </style>
  <line class="line" x1="4" y1="22" x2="124" y2="22"/>
  <text class="name" x="4" y="78">Muhammad Tanjeem</text>
  <text class="sub" x="4" y="108">CSE student at Daffodil International University</text>
  <text class="mono" x="4" y="134">learning cybersecurity and software development</text>
  <rect class="cursor" x="444" y="121" width="8" height="16"/>
<metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata></svg>
